Add the function style research post

Adds the twelfth research post, on func-style and no-use-before-define:
where hoisting and both rules came from, what TypeScript allows on each
form, what the research on reading order says, what converting 10,134
declarations in twelve codebases would break, and what Claude Code and
Codex did through Ultracite's agent fix with a clean file, a top-down
file and three mutually recursive functions.

The research behind it is in research/: a verified bibliography, the
func-style corpus scripts and results (inventory, linter runs, a
conversion and reordering simulation, history, calibration and a hand
classification), and a func-style agent-experiment topic with 24 runs.
Two shared corpus scripts now export helpers for reuse, without
changing their output.
